title: How to automate your entire business with no-code AI

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: No-code AI automates entire businesses by using pre-built workflows and AI integrations—no coding required. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But how do you scale? No-code tools lack the customization and deep API access needed for real business transformation. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: With platforms like Zapier and Make, you can connect 10,000+ apps and automate complex processes using AI-powered triggers and actions. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s just glue code. Real automation requires custom protocols and machine learning models, not just point-and-click interfaces. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Automation without control is just illusion—real growth needs code, not just AI-driven shortcuts. (4 sec)
